summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex identifier names, dictionary-mapped string decoding) and at install time downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, then invokes it via execFileSync against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle with string-array rotation and charset-decoder obfuscation (`WV8StW`, `n7gIxM`, `hc1jfK9`); its contents are not human-readable and its filename bears no relation to the package's advertised CSS/repo-config purpose. The tarball ships only setup.mjs and math_init.js alongside package.json/CHANGELOG; the `bin.ornikar-ci-comment-pr` entry point declared in package.json is absent, and no CSS/repo-config functionality is present. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated in-tree payload at preinstall bypasses inspection paths that only trace Node-resolved code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
